meta.name: game-development
meta.description: Game development orchestrator. Routes to platform-specific skills based on project needs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按游戏项目需要，自动套用对应平台开发流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做游戏开发，希望自动匹配不同平台的开发工具
copy.tagline_en: Pick and run the right platform-specific dev workflow automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a game and need to match the right platform tools automatically.

howto.what: Claude 会先说明游戏开发的核心原则（游戏循环、输入抽象、性能预算等），再根据目标平台、维度或专业领域推荐对应子技能，并给出相应指导。它会按项目选择 web、移动、PC 或 VR/AR 方向。
howto.when: 当你在进行游戏开发项目时触发，尤其是需要平台选型、2D/3D 判断或设计、联网等专业建议时。

say.text: 我想做一个浏览器端的 2D 平台跳跃游戏
say.note: 会导航到 web-games 和 2d-games 子技能。

say.text: 帮我规划一个 iOS/Android 解谜游戏，重点设计关卡平衡
我在做一个多人 VR 射击游戏，需要网络和渲染方面的建议

howto.what_en: Claude explains core game development principles (game loop, input abstraction, performance budgets), then recommends a sub-skill based on platform, dimension, or specialty, and routes to web, mobile, PC, or VR/AR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are working on a game development project, especially when you need help with platform selection, 2D/3D decisions, or a specialty such as design, networking, art, or audio.

say_en.text: I want to make a browser-based 2D platformer.
Help me plan an iOS/Android puzzle game with focus on level balance.
I'm building a multiplayer VR shooter and need networking and rendering advice.
